HOUSTON, Oct 30 (Reuters) - US oil majors ExxonMobil and Chevron both beat analyst expectations for quarterly profit on Friday, as soaring refining margins increased earnings from their fuel-making businesses - which typically have smaller profits - to rival the upstream segments.

The US-Israeli war on Iran and the conflict between Russia and Ukraine have disrupted global energy markets and sent gasoline and diesel prices higher.
